The '''Benkal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Benkal Plagues]].<ref name="SD">{{JournalCite|13|Scouts' Dispatch}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Benkal Plagues]]|system=Benkal [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Benkal system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square H-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
